item.text: [{"task_id":"2f767503","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    target = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    barrier = int(round(params['colors'][2]))","    marker = int(round(params['colors'][3]))","    out = grid.copy()","    marks = np.argwhere(grid == marker)","    bars = np.argwhere(grid == barrier)","    if len(marks) != 1 or len(bars) == 0:","        return out","    center = np.mean(bars, axis=0)","    row = int(round(center[0]))","    col = int(round(center[1]))","    dr = row - int(marks[0][0])","    dc = col - int(marks[0][1])","    if dr == 0 and dc == 0:","        return out","    neighbors = []","    for pair in params['neighbors']:","        neighbors.append((int(round(pair[0])), int(round(pair[1]))))","    height, width = grid.shape","    row += dr","    col += dc","    while 0 <= row < height and 0 <= col < width:","        if out[row, col] == target:","            pending = [(row, col)]","            out[row, col] = background","            while len(pending) > 0:","                r, c = pending.pop()","                for nr, nc in neighbors:","                    rr = r + nr","                    cc = c + nc","                    if 0 <= rr < height and 0 <= cc < width:","                        if out[rr, cc] == target:","                            out[rr, cc] = background","                            pending.append((rr, cc))","        row += dr","        col += dc","    return out"],"shapes":{"colors":[4],"neighbors":[4,2]},"params":{"colors":[7,4,5,9],"neighbors":[[-1,0],[1,0],[0,-1],[0,1]]},"rationale":"The gray bar fires a ray from its center away from the adjacent maroon marker. Every yellow component intersecting the ray is erased completely using orthogonal connectivity. Colors and connectivity are encoded in the tensors."}]
